provenance.reported_final_time_s: Section 5 reports 490 s; held fixed for the main comparison, not claimed as an independently recovered optimum.
provenance.intervals: Figure 3 contains 15 state vertices, hence 14 ZOH intervals. The text instead states N=15 steps.
provenance.initial_downrange_velocity_m_s: Figure 4 starts at approximately +200 m/s; the text instead states zero initial velocity.
provenance.gravity: Inverse-square parameters inferred from the red Figure 2 curve, rounded to g0=9.78 m/s^2 and R=100 km. The blue curve's interior knots are approximately 10,30,50,70,90 km; tangent centers 0,20,40,60,80,100 km explain Figures 2 and 4. Numerical constants and exact partitions are not supplied in the text. First/last zones are clipped to the plotted altitude domain.
provenance.polygon: Axis-aligned outer 32-gon inferred from the Figure 4 component plateaus and small norm overshoots. This differs from the inner polygon specified in Section 5. The maximum possible norm is 10/cos(pi/32)=10.048386 m/s^2. The strict inner-polygon alternative is also solved and reported.
provenance.domain: Altitude constrained to the Figure 2 model domain [0,100] km; numerical envelopes |downrange|<=100 km and |velocity components|<=2000 m/s are inactive at the reported solution. No monotonic-descent constraints are imposed.
